arm.base: Ua pre-map draw y = m + k*state + dyn (t2_arms.state_dynamics_draws, arm Ua)
arm.from: first capture with origin on or after the in-effect date; no backfill
arm.k: own k by final round section 3.5
arm.logged: as every T2 arm in T5 section 2.1
arm.name: Ul
arm.omega: added after the transform for poll targets; election day uses the interim noise law (T5 section 2.1)
arm.random_numbers: exactly Ua's z_state and z_dyn per (capture, target)
arm.transform: eps = y - m; eps_REST = -sum(eps); pi = (m, 100 - sum m); x_i = pi_i * exp(eps_i / max(pi_i, 0.5)); renormalize to 100

decision_use: as T5 section 6; the later preregistration should also name per-party Brier on P(share < 4%) before seeing it
